stops.title: Di Klas
stops.caption: Fo wik, ɛn wetin i de gi.
stops.speech: Mɛmbaship na di fo-wik klas. Fɔ finish am na wetin mek pɔsin Mɛmba fɔ tru, nɔ mata aw lɔng dɛn de kam.

stops.title: Koɔt dɛn
stops.caption: Intek, mak ɛn grajueshɔn.
stops.speech: Wan koɔt na wan intek. Yu skɛjul in fo sɛshɔn, mak atɛndans ɛn di las tɛst, ɛn grajuet di pipul we pas.
